ownership_rule: For incomplete NonMatching objects, emitted function bytes measure reconstruction coverage only; they do not claim contiguous ownership of the larger retail extent. Compiler-created local helpers are excluded unless they correspond to a separate retail symbol; the final TUs emit no such helper.
ownership_semantics: provisional reconstruction coverage, not contiguous retail ownership

alignment_method.reliability_test: The shared-body 3.189732% result is retired because it did not measure fn_80151600-specific source. Fresh independently compiled raw objdiff values are published transparently for all three functions, but are labeled raw alignment diagnostics rather than reconstruction-coverage percentages.
fn_80151600_structural_evidence: The final emitted body is distinct from fn_80150F20: 1264 versus 1272 bytes.
Retail and C both use fn_8017D908 in both flag branches; fn_80150F20 instead uses fn_8017D700 in its flag-1 branch.

The old 3.189732% was produced by one shared generated body. The independent body changes the raw objdiff diagnostic to 56.60491; this value is recorded transparently without treating it as source-coverage accounting.
